children: Trustmark completed a sale-leaseback with Blue Owl, selling 34 bank branch properties for $91.7 million and simultaneously entering long-term triple-net leases to continue operations. The branches span Mississippi, Florida, Tennessee, Alabama, and Texas. The leases begin at $6.4 million in aggregate annual rent with 1.5% yearly escalators, carry an initial 15-year term, and include three five-year renewal options. The sale generated an estimated $61.5 million pre-tax gain, and the company said no branches will close as part of the transaction.
